spec.mechanism: Leveraged longs pay shorts funding; a spot-long / perp-short holder collects it without predicting price. It should persist while leveraged-long demand exceeds supply and decay as the trade crowds.
spec.universe: 39 coins that passed Rule B in carry_coverage_detail.py; 1000SHIBUSDT excluded (different contract size).
spec.windows: each coin from its first settlement hour with spot, perp, mark and funding all present, to the last closed hour at the freeze date
disclosures: funding used as a direction signal in an earlier replay on 14 coins
historical run is a screen on seen data
dataset hashes recorded at the real run
spec.capital: 100 units; Rung 1 deploys all of it: 50 spot, 50 perp margin, equal notional (1x)
spec.benchmark: H applies to the same 100 units. Rung 1 earns NO H on top of its own return. Rung 2 credits H only to a coin's share of capital while that coin is OFF.
spec.funding: sum of actual settled records at their own timestamps (rate x perp qty x mark-candle open at the settlement hour); never records x 8h; received only if entry < settlement < exit
spec.rebalance: first 00:00 UTC of each month; restore equal notional and 50/50 split; costs on traded notional; no drift-triggered rebalance; coins entering or leaving mid-month trade at their window boundary with full costs
spec.price_pnl: spot and perp marked on hourly closes; missing spot hour 2023-03-24 13:00 uses the last price, count logged, sensitivity run without that day

liquidation.status: PLACEHOLDER, not verified, not called conservative
liquidation.trigger: mark-candle high pushes perp margin equity (margin - unrealized loss + funding - fees) below maintenance
liquidation.close_price: the maintenance-trigger price, not the candle high
liquidation.spot_leg: stays open at market; spot gain never tops up perp margin
liquidation.reentry: after 7 days with full entry costs; no margin top-ups
liquidation.report: events and closest approach (min margin equity / maintenance) per coin

rung2.filter: per coin at 00:00 UTC, trailing 30-day mean of settled funding records before the decision must be > 0
rung2.warmup: coin waits for 30 full days of records
rung2.run_only_if: Rung 1 calibration power at +1% per year is >= 80% (proxy, fixed now); otherwise logged INCONCLUSIVE and not run

spec.liquidity_rank: median daily quote volume (close x base volume summed per UTC day) from fade.db spot, 2023-11-11 to 2026-10-08; ties alphabetical; 5 lowest excluded in a robustness run only
spec.statistic: annualized mean daily net return on total capital of the equal-weight portfolio over active coins (calendar-time annualization)
spec.full_year_rule: a calendar year is gated only if >= 80% of coins in the portfolio were active all year; otherwise reported as partial
pass_bar_rung1: 99.5% one-sided lower bound of annualized net return > H at base costs
mean > H at stress costs (slippage 0.15%, maintenance 5%)
net return > 0 in every full calendar year
zero liquidation events in the base model, closest approach reported
max drawdown <= 10% of capital (screening threshold only)
same result without the 5 least-liquid coins
spec.family: 2 hypotheses (rung 1 vs H, rung 2 vs rung 1), 1% total budget, 0.5% each
spec.forward: weekly collection continues; data after the freeze date is unseen; confirmation needs >= 26 forward weeks with the same spec

calibration.selection: shortest block that passes every config at both seeds and pooled; if none passes, stop and do not test real profitability
calibration.covers: block-bootstrap lower bound on a synthetic daily-return series with persistent funding regimes and fat-tailed basis noise
calibration.does_not_cover: accounting, liquidation logic, costs, delistings; the real script needs its own self-checks
